# DJ'S Engine

> Web app by AC Digital App for DJs to organize their music library and playlists, analyze BPM and key, get smart next-track recommendations and import/export with VirtualDJ and Traktor.

## Key facts
- Website: https://djsengine.it/
- Publisher: AC Digital App (https://acdigitalapp.it)
- Languages: English (default), Italian
- Plans: Free (€0, up to 50 tracks, 1 crate); DJ Pro €3.99/month or €29.99/year (unlimited library and crates, VirtualDJ M3U export, trending tracks, smart AI recommendations, priority support)
- Payments: SumUp

## Pages
- [Home](https://djsengine.it/): product overview
- [Sign in / Register](https://djsengine.it/auth)
